04daaca9d4.q: What inspired Dr. Talal Al Sayed to become a doctor in the first place?
04daaca9d4.a: At age 10, Dr. Talal broke his hand and had an appointment with an orthopedic doctor (Dr. Muhammad) who showed him true human connection—laughing with him while giving health advice. That doctor demonstrated the real message behind medicine, and from that moment Dr. Talal told himself that medicine was the pathway he wanted to follow, sacrificing childhood playtime to enter medical school.

235295ff26.q: What problem did Dr. Talal Al Sayed experience that led him to create ATF?
235295ff26.a: In 2022, while his grandmother fell ill, Dr. Talal spent one month searching for a qualified nurse in Qatar, facing uncertainty about credentials, prices, and availability through Google, ChatGPT, and Instagram. This experience of fragmented, unclear post-hospital care services—what he calls the burden of uncertainty—haunted him through all his medical rotations. From 2022 to 2025, he could not unsee this problem affecting discharged patients and their families, which motivated him and his team to create ATF as a solution.

16feace5f6.q: Why is compassion central to ATF's design and mission?
16feace5f6.a: Dr. Talal insisted that ATF maintain compassion as its core, refusing to let a technical solution replace medicine's fundamental purpose. He and his team placed compassion in the app's name itself—ATF means compassion in Arabic—to send a clear message to the Qatari community. He emphasizes that healthcare is dignity, healthcare is someone you love in your house, and that care should not have any limits whether treating one patient in surgery or thousands through the app.

353c3ff566.q: What specific features does ATF provide for finding post-discharge nursing care?
353c3ff566.a: ATF is an app that connects nursing agencies like Neopress and displays available nurses with their pictures, reviews, nationality, credentials, experience, and feedback from other families. Users can see transparent pricing for nursing hours (e.g., six-hour shifts), check nurse availability in real time, and book directly without the uncertainty and fragmentation Dr. Talal experienced. The app solves three main problems: unclear reviews, unknown pricing, and lack of information about who will enter your home.

93ab2c0d9a.q: What is ATF's development status and future expansion roadmap?
93ab2c0d9a.a: ATF is currently 80 to 85% complete and planning to launch its first phase focused on nursing care for seamless nurse procurement without burden. After that, the team plans to expand to telehealth (video calling doctors), clinic booking, and pharmacies, with the ultimate vision of connecting all hospitals, healthcare organizations, agencies, and services in Qatar into one integrated app within three years.
